59072-the-secret-tomb.creator: Unknown
59072-the-secret-tomb.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. "To snare rabbits," she said. "There's nothing wrong in it, you see. But come, there's been talk enough about it. Go to by-by again, boys. And above all, Castor and Pollux, don't fight. The Captain's asleep; and he doesn't like to be disturbed, the Captain doesn't."

arxiv-2105-12790.title: Efficient Quantum Public-Key Encryption From Learning With Errors
arxiv-2105-12790.creator: Javad Doliskani
arxiv-2105-12790.description: Abstract Our main result is a quantum public-key encryption scheme based on the Extrapolated Dihedral Coset problem (EDCP) which is equivalent, under quantum polynomial-time reductions, to the Learning With Errors (LWE) problem. For limited number of public keys (roughly linear in the security parameter), the proposed scheme is information-theoretically secure.

arxiv-2110-06289.title: Grid-based calculation of Lagrangian mean
arxiv-2110-06289.creator: Hossein A. Kafiabad 1
arxiv-2110-06289.description: Abstract Lagrangian averaging has been shown to be more effective than Eulerian mean in separating waves from slow dynamics in two-timescale flows. It also appears in many reduced models that capture the wave feedback on the slow flow. Its calculation, however, requires tracking particles in time, which imposes several difficulties in grid-based numerical simulations or estimation from fixed-point measurements.

arxiv-2111-04682.title: SMU: smooth activation function for deep networks using smoothing maximum technique
arxiv-2111-04682.creator: Koushik Biswas, Sandeep Kumar, Shilpak Banerjee, Ashish Kumar Pandey
arxiv-2111-04682.description: Abstract Deep learning researchers have a keen interest in proposing two new novel activation functions which can boost network performance. A good choice of activation function can have significant consequences in improving network performance. A handcrafted activation is the most common choice in neural network models.

arxiv-2112-12152.title: Prediction of Astrometric-Microlensing Events from Gaia eDR3 Proper Motions Journal: AJ The results of the predicted microlensing events is available in electronic form via the GAVO Data Center https://dc.g-vo.org/amlensing/q3/q/form The source code for this study is made publicly available https://
arxiv-2112-12152.creator: Jonas Klüter, Ulrich Bastian, Markus Demleitner, Joachim Wambsganss
arxiv-2112-12152.description: Abstract Astrometric microlensing is a unique tool to measure stellar masses. It allows us to determine the mass of the lensing star with an accuracy of a few per cent. In this paper, we update, extend, and refine our predictions of astrometric-microlensing events based on Gaia’s early Data release 3 (eDR3). We selected about 500.

arxiv-2203-04033.title: Reappraisal of Whitham’s 1967 theory for
arxiv-2203-04033.creator: wave-meanflow interaction in shallow water
arxiv-2203-04033.description: Abstract Abstract. The modulation equations for Stokes waves in shallow water coupled to wave-generated meanflow, derived in Whitham (1967), based on an averaged Lagrangian are re-visited. Firstly, it is shown that they can be recast into two coupled classical shallow water equations, with modified gravity having the sign of the Whitham index: {\rm sign}(\omega_{0}^{\prime\prime}\omega_{2}) .

arxiv-2304-06020.title: VidStyleODE: Disentangled Video Editing via StyleGAN and NeuralODEs
arxiv-2304-06020.creator: Moayed Haji Ali Andrew Bond Koç University, Tolga Birdal, Duygu Ceylan, Levent Karacan, Erkut Erdem, Aykut Erdem
arxiv-2304-06020.description: Abstract We propose VidStyleODE , a spatiotemporally continuous disentangled vid eo representation based upon Style GAN and Neural- ODE s. Effective traversal of the latent space learned by Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) has been the basis for recent breakthroughs in image editing.

arxiv-2306-04864.title: Extraction of XUV+IR ionization amplitudes from the circular dichroic phase
arxiv-2306-04864.creator: Anatoli S. Kheifets
arxiv-2306-04864.description: Abstract A strong helicity dependence of reconstruction of attosecond bursts by beating of two-photon transitions (RABBITT) with circularly polarized XUV and IR pulses was reported by Han et al. [Nature Physics 19, 230 and arXiv 2302.04137 (2023)]. They attributed a circular dichroic phase in RABBITT to the helical structure of the photoelectron wave packets in the final state.

arxiv-2404-07015.title: POD Suboptimal Control of Evolution Problems Theory and Applications
arxiv-2404-07015.creator: S. Banholzer, D. Beermann, L. Mechelli, S. Volkwein
arxiv-2404-07015.description:
A 2024 arXiv research paper by S. Banholzer, D. Beermann, L. Mechelli, S. Volkwein. Chapter 1
Introduction

The optimization and control of systems governed by
partial differential equations (PDEs)
usually requires numerous evaluations of the forward problem or the optimality system. Despite the fact that many recent efforts have been made to limit or reduce the number of evaluations to 5-10, this cannot be achieved in all situations and even if this is possible, these evaluations may still require a formidable computational effort.

arxiv-2404-10046.title: Observation of Cooper-pair density modulation state
arxiv-2404-10046.creator: Lingyuan Kong, Michał Papaj, Hyunjin Kim, Yiran Zhang, Eli Baum, Hui Li, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Genda Gu, Patrick A. Lee, Stevan Nadj-Perge
arxiv-2404-10046.description:
A 2024 arXiv research paper by Lingyuan Kong, Michał Papaj, Hyunjin Kim, Yiran Zhang, Eli Baum, Hui Li, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Genda Gu, Patrick A. Lee, Stevan Nadj-Perge. Superconducting states that break space-group symmetries of the underlying crystal can exhibit nontrivial
spatial modulation of the order parameter.

arxiv-2407-08134.title: Highway Networks for Improved Surface Reconstruction: The Role of Residuals and Weight Updates
arxiv-2407-08134.creator: A. Noorizadegan, Y.C. Hon, D.L. Young, C.S. Chen
arxiv-2407-08134.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by A. Noorizadegan, Y.C. Hon, D.L. Young, C.S. Chen. Surface reconstruction from point clouds is a fundamental challenge in computer graphics and medical imaging. In this paper, we explore the application of advanced neural network architectures for the accurate and efficient reconstruction of surfaces from data points. We introduce a novel variant of the Highway network (Hw) called Square-Highway (SqrHw) within the context of multilayer perceptrons and investigate its performance alongside plain neural networks and a simplified Hw in various numerical examples.

arxiv-2409-03160.title: Autonomous Drifting Based on Maximal Safety Probability Learning
arxiv-2409-03160.creator: Hikaru Hoshino, Jiaxing Li, Arnav Menon, John M. Dolan, Yorie Nakahira
arxiv-2409-03160.description: Abstract This paper proposes a novel learning-based framework for autonomous driving based on the concept of maximal safety probability. Efficient learning requires rewards that are informative of desirable/undesirable states, but such rewards are challenging to design manually due to the difficulty of differentiating better states among many safe states.

arxiv-2502-08408.title: Lüroth Expansions in Diophantine Approximation: Metric Properties and Conjectures
arxiv-2502-08408.creator: Ying Wai Lee
arxiv-2502-08408.description: Abstract . This paper focuses on the metric properties of Lüroth well approximable numbers, studying analogous of classical results, namely the Khintchine Theorem, the Jarník–Besicovitch Theorem, and the result of Dodson. A supplementary proof is provided for a measure-theoretic statement originally proposed by Tan–Zhou. The Beresnevich–Velani Mass Transference Principle is applied to extend a dimensional result of Cao–Wu–Zhang.

arxiv-2505-24760.title: Reasoning Gym : Reasoning Environments for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
arxiv-2505-24760.creator: Zafir Stojanovski, Oliver Stanley, Joe Sharratt, Richard Jones, Abdulhakeem Adefioye, Jean Kaddour, Andreas Köpf
arxiv-2505-24760.description: Abstract We introduce Reasoning Gym ( RG), a library of reasoning environments for reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards. It provides over 100 data generators and verifiers spanning multiple domains including algebra, arithmetic, computation, cognition, geometry, graph theory, logic, and various common games.

europmc-pmc4624425.title: Using qualitative evidence in decision making for health and social interventions: an approach to assess confidence in findings from qualitative evidence syntheses (GRADE-CERQual).
europmc-pmc4624425.creator: Lewin S, Glenton C, Munthe-Kaas H, Carlsen B, Colvin CJ, Gülmezoglu M, Noyes J, Booth A, Garside R, Rashidian A.
europmc-pmc4624425.description: Simon Lewin and colleagues present a methodology for increasing transparency and confidence in qualitative research synthesis.

plos-pone-0005628.title: Anode Biofilm Transcriptomics Reveals Outer Surface Components Essential for High Density Current Production in Geobacter sulfurreducens Fuel Cells
plos-pone-0005628.creator: Kelly P. Nevin, Byoung-Chan Kim, Richard H. Glaven et al.
plos-pone-0005628.description: PLOS ONE research article. The mechanisms by which Geobacter sulfurreducens transfers electrons through relatively thick (>50 µm) biofilms to electrodes acting as a sole electron acceptor were investigated. Biofilms of Geobacter sulfurreducens were grown either in flow-through systems with graphite anodes

pmc-10631221.title: Biocatalytic reductive amination as a route to isotopically labelled amino acids suitable for analysis of large proteins by NMR†
pmc-10631221.creator: Jack S. Rowbotham, Jake H. Nicholson, Miguel A. Ramirez, Kouji Urata, Peter M. T. Todd, Gogulan Karunanithy, Lars Lauterbach, Holly A. Reeve, Andrew J. Baldwin, Kylie A. Vincent
pmc-10631221.description: We demonstrate an atom-efficient and easy to use H2-driven biocatalytic platform for the enantioselective incorporation of 2H-atoms into amino acids. By combining the biocatalytic deuteration catalyst with amino acid dehydrogenase enzymes capable of reductive amination, we synthesised a library of multiply isotopically labelled amino acids from low-cost isotopic precursors, such as 2H2O and 15NH4+.

pmc-10726994.description: ion initiation in patients eligible for catheter ablation: a randomized controlled study.’ In the letter to the editor, Kataoka et al. warrant a more extensive examination to enhance the comprehensiveness of our findings. After conducting a study and analysing data, it is usual to reflect on potential areas for improvement or further thoroughness.

pmc-10824962.title: Hexokinase-linked glycolytic overload and unscheduled glycolysis in hyperglycemia-induced pathogenesis of insulin resistance, beta-cell glucotoxicity, and diabetic vascular complications
pmc-10824962.creator: Naila Rabbani, Paul J. Thornalley
pmc-10824962.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Hyperglycemia is a risk factor for the development of insulin resistance, beta-cell glucotoxicity, and vascular complications of diabetes. We propose the hypothesis, hexokinase-linked glycolytic overload and unscheduled glycolysis, in explanation. Hexokinases (HKs) catalyze the first step of glucose metabolism. Increased flux of glucose metabolism through glycolysis gated by HKs, when occurring without concomitant increased activity of glycolytic enzymes—unscheduled glycolysis—produces increased levels of glycolytic intermediates with overspill into effector pathways of cell dysfunction and pathogenesis.

pmc-11339292.title: Insights into Hip pain using Hip X-ray: Epidemiological study of 8,898,044 Koreans
pmc-11339292.creator: Taewook Kim, Yoonhee Kim, Woosup Cho
pmc-11339292.description: Hip pain is a prevalent degenerative joint symptoms, imposing a significant global health burden. Hip pain is experiencing an increase in incidences in Korea due to its aging society, and the social burden of hip pain continues to rise as the hip joint is crucial for gait and balance.

pmc-11354213.title: Household Compositions and Substance Use among Young Adults in the U.S.
pmc-11354213.creator: Beth Han, Naomi Tomoyasu, Emily B Einstein, Christopher M Jones, Wilson M Compton, Carla Berg, Paul B Tchounwou
pmc-11354213.description: Background: Adults aged 21–29 have the highest past-month prevalence of tobacco, alcohol, and illicit drug use in the U.S. Currently, young adults often delay traditional adulthood milestones (e.g., marriage and childbearing), which may impact their household composition and substance use.

pmc-12651517.title: Mediating Similarity: An Information-Theoretic Principle of Reference Behavior
pmc-12651517.creator: Qun Zhao, Menghui Yang, Guojian Xian, Jieying Bi, Tan Sun, Nikolay K Vitanov
pmc-12651517.description: While information theory is widely used to quantify knowledge combinations, the fundamental principles guiding reference selection in science remain largely unexplored. This study analyzes a large-scale journal citation network to introduce and empirically validate a principle we term “Mediating Similarity”.

pmc-12661446.title: Trapping tiny pollutants: SERS-driven strategies for microplastics and nanoplastics detection
pmc-12661446.creator: Jayasree Kumar, Phularida Amulraj, Sadia Fatima Haroon, Rangabhashiyam Selvasembian, Venugopal Rao Soma, Rajapandiyan Panneerselvam
pmc-12661446.description: SummaryMicroplastics and nanoplastics are almost everywhere in biological and environmental systems, posing serious risks to human health and ecology. However, due to their complex matrices, varied sizes, and morphologies, their detection and quantification remain challenging. Particularly, Raman and surface-enhanced Raman spectroscopy (SERS) hold great promise for the detection, characterization, and quantification of micro/nanoplastics.

pmc-12714764.title: Temporal endocrine and hematological consequences of biological extremes in porcine birth weight
pmc-12714764.creator: Alyssa A. Smith, Dayeon Jeon, Kaylyn Rudy, Sarah Innis, J. Scott Radcliffe, J.Alex Pasternak
pmc-12714764.description: To characterize the potential long-term impact of intrauterine growth restriction (IUGR), we assessed the endocrine and hematological consequences of IUGR at birth and in the early postnatal period. Piglets (n = 911) were collected pre-suckling, weighed, and blood sampled, with rectal temperatures assessed two hours later, and sampling repeated at 20 days of age (D20).

pmc-12818783.title: Editorial: Frailty- and age-associated diseases: possibilities for intervention (Volume 2)
pmc-12818783.creator: Consuelo Borrás, José Viña, Cristina Mas-Bargues
pmc-12818783.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). sors, and accelerate the functional decline. This second volume of the Frailty- and Age-Associated Diseases Research Topic brings together twelve complementary contributions that collectively highlight emerging opportunities for risk stratification, early identification, and intervention in older adults. From functional and biological biomarkers to multicomponent interventions and methodological roadmaps, this Research Topic provides a multidimensional overview of the current and future directions in frailty research.

pmc-12830576.title: Secure localization of land vehicles under GPS spoofing attack with decomposition Kalman filter
pmc-12830576.creator: Meihong Zhao, Zhengxiao Han, Ende Wang, Jiageng Liu
pmc-12830576.description: This study presents a secure vehicle localization framework designed to maintain accuracy under GPS spoofing attacks. The framework integrates a spoofing detection mechanism operating in three adaptive modes and employs refined dynamic, measurement, and attack models. A decomposition-based Kalman filter is utilized to develop a fusion algorithm for robust state estimation.

pmc-13225506.title: ABO and RhD blood group distributions in Gansu Province, China: A retrospective study based on donor and patient data
pmc-13225506.creator: Xiang Zhang, Miaomiao Liu, Kang Liu, Yigang He
pmc-13225506.description: The distribution of ABO and Rhesus D (RhD) blood groups is crucial for ensuring the safety of blood transfusions and for optimal blood donation planning. Gansu Province in Northwest China is characterized by remarkable ethnic diversity, which may contribute to a unique blood group distribution pattern in this region.

pmc-13338882.title: Multi‐country outbreak of Salmonella Stanley ST2045 infections linked to consumption of flavoured noodle products. 1 July 2026
pmc-13338882.creator: Unknown
pmc-13338882.description: An outbreak of Salmonella Stanley ST2045 is ongoing in the European Union/European Economic Area (EU/EEA), with a total of 106 confirmed cases having been reported by 13 EU/EEA countries (77) and the United Kingdom (29) between November 2025 and June 2026. The outbreak is mainly affecting children and young adults, and has involved at least 49 hospitalisations.

pmc-13402688.title: Design of an ultra-compact and high-performance antenna for private 5G applications
pmc-13402688.creator: Youjin Han, Jae-Geun Lee, Byung Kuon Ahn
pmc-13402688.description: This paper presents an ultra-compact and high-performance antenna for Private 5G applications. Private 5G applications, which provide customized coverage, face the challenge of simultaneously achieving bandwidths exceeding 100 MHz, stable gain, and miniaturization. In general, small antennas have a trade-off between physical size and bandwidth and gain, which limits their practical applications.

pmc-13422307.title: Temporal variations in the gut microbiota of François’ langur (Trachypithecus francoisi): implications for adaptation to seasonal dietary change and conservation
pmc-13422307.creator: Jialiang Han, Jinyuan Liu, Tao Wang, Bingnan Dong, Fan Zhang, Siyao Li, Qixian Zou, Diyan Li
pmc-13422307.description: Despite growing research on gut microbiota in wild primates, seasonal functional dynamics of the gut microbiota in this endangered folivorous species remain poorly understood. This study investigates the seasonal variations in the gut microbiota of François’ langur (Trachypithecus francoisi) and their implications for dietary adaptation and conservation.

pmc-13563130.title: Effect of intrinsic sphincter deficiency on treatment success following urethral bulking with polyacrylamide hydrogel
pmc-13563130.creator: Bertie Geng, Layla Joudeh, Ayanna Garland, Elizabeth J. Geller
pmc-13563130.description: PurposeIntrinsic sphincter deficiency (ISD) is associated with lower stress urinary incontinence (SUI) treatment success. Polyacrylamide hydrogel (PH) is a widely used urethral bulking material in treating SUI. Our goal is to compare treatment outcomes in women with and without ISD who underwent urethral bulking with PH for SUI.
